note: CLEAN PASS with three disclosed deviations from literal transcription, all in the direction of less text rather than more. (1) The GSS codebook prints the battery stem with an interviewer direction appended -- 'Please tell me whether or not you think it should be possible for a pregnant woman to obtain a legal abortion if. . .READ EACH STATEMENT, AND CIRCLE ONE CODE FOR EACH.' -- and only the respondent-facing half is shipped in `instructions`; the all-caps clause is addressed to the interviewer, not the participant. (2) Each statement is printed with a battery letter ('A. If there is a strong chance...'); the A-G markers are stripped per the leading-numbering rule, and the file is written in battery order A-G so the position is still recoverable. (3) abhlth's codebook page renders the possessive as a curly-quote artifact, 'the woman”s own health'; shipped with a straight apostrophe. Nothing else was normalised. Response coding: the GSS itself codes 1=yes, 2=no; stevedata::gss_abortion (the Rdatasets source that data/Rdatasets.R reads as gss_abortion.csv) recodes to 1=supports legal abortion in that circumstance / 0=does not, which is what the live table holds and what option_text 'Yes'/'No' is mapped onto -- corroborated numerically, see verification. Response-table scope note (not an issues-page matter, it is about the response data): abany has n=36,794 against ~44,000 for the other six, because abany was first asked in 1977 and sits on a different ballot rotation; it is a real design feature of the GSS, not missingness introduced by the IRW script. Rights: no restriction is locatable to quote. The only statement on gss.norc.org is the site footer 'Copyright © 2026 NORC. All rights reserved.', which is a notice about the site rather than a term governing the instrument (the PANAS case), and norc.org/terms-and-conditions returns no substantive clause. GSS question wording is republished in full by NORC's own codebook, ICPSR, Berkeley SDA and gssrdoc. Silence is permission, so no block, and no instrument_rights_register row was written (a round may never write `ship`).
